name: wpf-xaml-ls
description: Completion, diagnostics, quick fixes, hover and go to definition for WPF XAML, with your project's types, resources and bindings.

wpfXamlLs.serverPath.markdownDescription: Command that starts the language server. The default expects the .NET tool on your PATH: `dotnet tool install -g WpfXaml.LanguageServer --prerelease`.

wpfXamlLs.solution.markdownDescription: The `.sln`, `.slnx` or `.csproj` to load, relative to the workspace folder. By default the server finds one under the workspace folder.

wpfXamlLs.loadProjects.markdownDescription: Load projects with MSBuild. When off, only WPF framework types are known.

wpfXamlLs.frameworkVersion.markdownDescription: Major version of the WPF targeting pack used before a project loads (for example `8`). By default the highest installed version.

wpfXamlLs.trace.server.markdownDescription: Log the LSP messages between VS Code and the server, in the **WPF XAML** output channel.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out dist/wpf-xaml-ls.vsix
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build-test && node out-test/runTest.js
